'''Mandallian Narcolethe''' was a powerful [[Alcohol/Legends|alcoholic]] beverage. Produced by the [[Mandallian Giant]]s<ref name="GG9" /> of [[Mandallia]], a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim's]] [[Mandalore system/Legends|Mandalore system]],<ref name="TEA" /> Narcolethe became famous across the Outer Rim for the level of its potency, and was believed by many to be good for little more than [[Starship/Legends|ship]] [[Fuel/Legends|fuel]].<ref name="TCSWE" /> Over [[Time/Legends|time]], Mandallian Narcolethe came to be seen by many of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] residents as the definitive [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] beverage. Despite this, Narcolethe's popularity among the Mandalorian community was rivaled strongly by [[Black ale/Legends|''ne'tra gal'']], a sweet [[black]] [[Ale/Legends|ale]].<ref name="TMPaC" />

Developed several millennia prior to the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]],<ref name="TCSWE" /> Narcolethe was introduced to the Mandalorian culture by the Mandallians whom they adopted into their clans after conquering Mandallia.<ref name="TEA" /> During the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]], [[Mandalorian Crusaders]] were known to feed their [[Basilisk war droid/Legends|Basilisk war droids]] a mixture of unrefined Narcolethe and [[Locap/Legends|locap]] [[Plasma/Legends|plasma]].<ref name="TCSWE" /> In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[200 BBY/Legends|200 BBY]], members of the Mandalorian [[Soldier/Legends|warrior]] clans engaged and defeated the [[Ithullan]]s in a [[Mandalorian–Ithullan war|war]] over a Narcolethe distillery.<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>

The ''[[Oyu'baat]]'' [[Tapcafe/Legends|tapcaf]]—the oldest [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] on the planet [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]], located in the planet's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Keldabe/Legends|Keldabe]]—kept a large stock of Mandallian Narcolethe for its customers.<ref name="Revelation">''[[Legacy of the Force: Revelation]]''</ref> Members of the [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] were known for drinking Mandallian Narcolethe in excess, and Narcolethe was also a favored drink of the Mandalorian soldiers and [[Constable/Legends|constables]] [[Fenn Shysa]] and [[Tobbi Dala]]. The two enjoyed having a mug of Narcolethe together after work.<ref name="HotM" /> A bottle of Narcolethe or ''ne'tra gal'' was considered a good way to celebrate an event in Mandalorian culture, such the [[Gai bal manda|adoption]] of a new member of a clan.<ref name="APM">''[[Boba Fett: A Practical Man]]''</ref>

[[Sair Yonka]], a non-Mandalorian [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] from [[Commenor/Legends|Commenor]], also enjoyed Mandallian Narcolethe.<ref name="BactaWar">''[[X-Wing: The Bacta War]]''</ref>
